units.source_text: 当然，如今个把人失踪了，也不是什么希罕事。

en.t: Of course, these days, one person or so going missing is hardly anything unusual.

units.source_text: 仅从统计数字来看，一年间就有几百件失踪案件。

en.t: Judging from the statistics alone, there are several hundred missing-person cases in a single year.

units.source_text: 然而，人被找到的可能性却微乎其微。

en.t: And yet the chance that the person will be found is extremely slight.

units.source_text: 换了杀人事件或者人身事故，怎么都会留下清晰的证据，

en.t: In a murder case or a personal accident, clear evidence is bound to be left behind one way or another,

units.source_text: 就连绑架，有关人员也总会明显地表示出大概的动机。

en.t: and even in a kidnapping, the people involved usually reveal some fairly obvious motive.

units.source_text: 然而失踪者却不属此列，极难找到线索。

en.t: But missing persons do not fall into that category, and clues are extremely hard to find.

units.source_text: 如果有“纯粹逃亡”的说法，那么，多数失踪事件，似乎都可纳入“纯粹逃亡”的范围。

en.t: If there is such a thing as pure flight, then most disappearances seem as though they could be included within that category.
